name: intellistory
description: IntelliStory skills for AI agents: story development, critique, look development, breakdown/layout/storyboards, image/video/audio generation, guided production mentoring, ingest, and full-quality HDR/EXR masters and production art packs — driven through the intellistory CLI or the IntelliStory MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Develop stories, looks, boards and shots in IntelliStory
interface.longDescription: IntelliStory Skills turn Codex into a pre-production collaborator: develop a story from a spark to a tagged script, get structured critique, define the visual language, break a script into sequences and shots, run layout, board and render shots with cost estimates first, be mentored through a whole production, and ingest scripts, references and renders. Uses the intellistory CLI (or the IntelliStory MCP) for authenticated work and returns deep links into the project.
